title: Indian-Style Lentil Curry
description: A flavorful and nutritious curry made with red lentils, Indian spices, and a hint of glaze. Perfect for a comforting meal on a chilly evening.
instructions: In a large saucepan, sauté the chopped onion and grated ginger in a little water until softened.
Add the red lentils, curry powder, and salt. Stir well to combine.
Add the water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
Transfer the saucepan to the preheated oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the oven and stir in the glaze (if using).
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro (if desired).
Note: If using a glaze, reduce the amount of salt used in the recipe.
